task_title: DuckBrain watchdog has no recovery teeth: auto-restart on N consecutive DARK probes
task_criteria: A maintenance stop of duckbrain-http results in automatic recovery within <=5 min with no manual action: a confirm-probe + consecutive-dark counter + cooldown recovery unit performs systemctl --user start duckbrain-http.service; HUNG probes never trigger recovery; recovery path is unit-tested, documented in docs/guide/deployment.md, and proven by a live stop-drill.
